title: IDPhotoWork Photo Specification Dataset: passport, visa and ID photo requirements for 164 countries
description:
A machine-readable dataset of official photo requirements for passports, visas, identity cards, driving licences and other documents, covering 164 countries and territories and 724 unique documents.

Each record carries the print size in millimetres and pixels, the required background colour, the resolution the spec is written for, and — where the issuing authority publishes them — the chin-to-crown head height, the eye-line position, whether glasses are permitted, whether a neutral expression is legally binding, and the maximum age of the photo.

Values were collected from issuing authorities and cross-checked against at least two independent sources. Records that could not be reconciled are either omitted or flagged needsReview with every candidate value preserved in data/quality-report.json. Country-level deviations from the ICAO baseline are documented explicitly (for example the Netherlands at 26–30 mm instead of the Schengen 32–36 mm, Switzerland at 29–34 mm, South Africa requiring a light grey or cream background).

Available as a single JSON array (specs.json), a CSV export, and per-country JSON files. A JSON Schema is included, together with the Python build and validation scripts that generate the dataset from the source catalogue.

Maintained by IDPhotoWork (https://www.idphotowork.com/), a free online passport and ID photo maker. Corrections with an official source attached are welcome via the GitHub issue tracker.
